artworks.title: Das Gastmahl des Trimalchio: pl. V (The Banquet of Trimalchio: pl. V)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on Zanders wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around a table with a small animal in the center. The scene is depicted using intricate lines that convey movement. The figures are sketched with a lively style that suggests a lively gathering. The background is filled with hatching and cross-hatching. The drawing captures a sense of dynamic interaction among the figures, with the animal adding a focal point. The attention to detail in the lines and shading conveys a sense of drama in the scene.

artworks.title: Das Gastmahl des Trimalchio: pl. VII (The Banquet of Trimalchio: pl. VII)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image displays a beach scene illustrated in a sketch-like style. A man wearing a hat and a short outfit stands on the left, with a dog beside him. Another man, naked, faces the water on the right. The horizon is at the upper third of the image, with a bright light source in the sky. The sky has clouds and distant land formations. The brushstrokes are rapid and fluid, giving a sense of movement. The color scheme is black and off-white, creating high contrast and emphasizing the figures and landscape.

artworks.title: Das Gastmahl des Trimalchio: pl. XI (The Banquet of Trimalchio: pl. XI)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on J. W. Zanders wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring abstract forms that suggest human caricatures with exaggerated features and dynamic poses. On the left is a whimsical face with a mischievous expression, crafted with bold, angular lines. In the center, a figure appears to be in motion, with limbs extended in a dance-like posture. To the right, two more ambiguous figures are depicted. One has a rounder form and robe-like garment, while the other has an oversized head and large eyes, seemingly observing from the background. The drawing style is loose and expressive, with quick, gestural marks giving a sense of lively interaction among the figures.

artworks.title: Die Opferung Isaacs (The Sacrifice of Isaac)
artworks.artist: Lovis Corinth after Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: This is a painting featuring figures in a chaotic setting. The image contains dark, swirling lines and forms. The central focus is a scene with multiple interconnected figures within a densely textured environment. The use of lines and shading creates depth and complexity in the composition with a dramatic intensity. This is in the style of Francisco Goya.

artworks.title: Der Fahnenträger (The Standard Bearer)
artworks.medium: drypoint and roulette in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image features a portrait showing the upper part of a man's body. The man has a prominent mustache, broad nose, and a determined expression. He is wearing classical armor and holding a flag or pole. The word "Der Fahnenträger" is written below the figure. The background is shaded and textured.

artworks.title: Aus dem Tiergarten (View of the Tiergarten)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on J. W. Zanders wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a scene with a bridge slightly above the center. The bridge's line marks the horizon, with figures moving along it. In the distance are tree branches reaching upward, creating a web-like pattern. A lamppost is on the left of the bridge. The style features energetic brushstrokes and line work. The color palette is monochromatic, with dark shades against a lighter background. Water in the foreground reflects the bridge and vertical pole details, blending with the background lines.

artworks.title: Der Dichter (The Poet)
artworks.medium: drypoint and roulette in black on J. W. Zanders wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a seated man from the waist up. The man is leaning slightly forward, with his head turned towards the viewer. He has prominent facial features, including a bushy beard and mustache, along with wavy hair combed back. He is wearing a suit with a jacket and bow tie, holding a sheet of paper in his hands. The background consists of vertical and diagonal lines, implying the presence of another object or a curtain to his left, providing a textured backdrop. The image is primarily monochromatic, emphasizing contrasts and lines within the image.

artworks.title: Sonntagsreiter (Sunday Riders)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on J. W. Zanders laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: This is a drawing of horses and riders. The sketch depicts three horses with riders on their backs, drawn in a loose style using quick, fluid lines. The figures are suggested rather than fully rendered, capturing a sense of movement and spontaneity. The use of minimal lines conveys the essential forms and actions of the horses and riders. The background is sparse, focusing attention on the central figures and their interaction.

artworks.title: Des Künstlers Schwiegermutter (The Artist's Mother-in-Law)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows an individual's upper body and head facing forward but slightly turned to the viewer's left. The person has expressive facial features with strong lines for the eyes, nose, and mouth, along with dark wavy hair swept back from the forehead. They are wearing a high-collared garment with one hand raised to the chest area, and a large circular pendant or brooch. The background is plain, emphasizing the individual.

artworks.title: Selbstbildnis (Self-Portrait)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of an individual from the upper torso up. The person is angled slightly with the face turned towards the viewer. The facial features include a mustache and deep-set eyes, with shadows accentuating the facial contours. The hair is covered by a wide-brimmed hat shaded dark with crosshatching. The individual is wearing a collared shirt visible beneath a coat. The background is plain, and the artwork is signed by the artist at the bottom.

artworks.title: Bildnis K.S. (Portrait of K.S.)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image features a sketchy etching of a person's upper body. The person is depicted as sitting with their head resting on their hand, facing slightly to the left. The individual has closed eyes, a prominent nose, short dark hair, and is wearing a jacket over a collared shirt. The background is plain, emphasizing the textured and shaded strokes of the etching.

artworks.title: Bildnisstudie H. St. (Portrait Study of H. St.)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image is a line drawing of a man, showing him from the chest up. The man is in a side profile position, facing towards the right side of the image. His facial features are sketched, and he has a beard. His hair is short and combed back. He is wearing a jacket and a buttoned shirt. The background is plain. The bottom of the image features an artist's signature.

artworks.title: Katzenstudie (Study of Cats)
artworks.medium: drypoint and open-bite etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy

artworks.title: Henny Porten
artworks.medium: softground etching on J. W. Zanders laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing the head and shoulders of a person facing forward. The facial features are bold with prominent eyes, a wide nose, and lips. The hair is depicted with loose, flowing lines, framing the face and extending to the shoulders. The clothing around the shoulders is indistinct, with abstract lines suggesting texture or pattern. The background is plain. There is a signature or writing below the sketch.

artworks.title: Titelbild (Title Page)
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a man's bust in the upper right corner. The man has a neutral expression, short dark hair, and a pointed beard, wearing a high-collared garment. Below the bust are figures on horseback. The background has abstract lines. In the top left, there is handwritten-style text saying "Wallensteins Lager" and a signature in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: "Vater, es wird nicht gut ablaufen, bleiben wir von dem soldatenhaufen" ("Father, This Won't Turn Out Well, We should stay away from the gang of soldiers")
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image features intricate lines and dense hatchings creating abstract shapes that overlap. The forms suggest human figures amidst a chaotic background. The arrangement of lines and shapes evokes figures in flowing garments, appearing as a crowd in motion. The artwork shows depth and texture, with contrasts between densely drawn lines and lighter areas.

artworks.title: "Einer dirne schön gesicht muss allgemein sein wie's sonnenlicht" ("A Pretty Girl's Face is Like the Sunshine")
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image is an etching featuring multiple figures shown from the waist up, concentrating on their upper bodies and heads. The figures are close together, implying an interaction or conversation. Their facial features are detailed with expressive and textured lines. The individuals have various hairstyles, some possibly wearing hats. Their clothing is depicted with loose, dynamic lines, suggesting layers of fabric like coats or dresses. The minimalistic background lacks a discernible setting or objects and the focus remains on the figures. Handwritten text at the top adds visual elements but is not clearly legible. The scene displays dynamic interactions and textural contrasts created by the etching technique.

artworks.title: "Was der blitz! Das ist ja die gustel von blasewitz" ("What's That! It's Gustel von Blasewitz")
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image features intricate lines and shapes forming an abstract composition. Dark and light areas create outlines and shadows resembling figures around a table. The figures seem sketchy and undefined, reminiscent of people gathered closely together. Swirling lines and curves suggest movement and complexity, while handwritten text at the top adds intrigue.

artworks.title: Kapuzinerpredigt—"Hetzt sich lieber herum mit der Dirn'" (The Capuchin's Sermon—"He Prefers to Run Around with a Girl")
artworks.medium: etching in black on Van Gelder Zonen laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image features swirling lines and dense cross-hatches creating a dark and heavy texture in an abstract composition. Within the chaotic strokes, there are hints of a human figure or face emerging. The piece evokes organic forms suggestive of figures in motion or struggle, allowing viewers to find familiar shapes like limbs or faces in a mist.

artworks.title: "Wohl auf, kameraden, aufs pferd, aufs pferd! Ins feld, in die freiheit gezogen!" ("Come On, Comrades, to Horse, to Horse! To Battle, Bound for Liberty!")
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring abstract figures and objects depicted with dense, dark lines. The background consists of diagonal lines and scribbles. The composition shows a contrast between dark and light areas, creating a dynamic atmosphere.

artworks.title: Herd of Sheep Under Trees
artworks.medium: etching and soft-ground etching on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Otto Donner
artworks.description: Printed with energetic black lines and hatching against cream white paper, dozens of sheep graze in the deep shadows cast by a grove of trees in this horizontal landscape etching. The horizon runs lengthwise across the center of the sheet, and the sheep graze between two neat rows of trees that recede into the distance. The ground gently rises on either side of the sheep, and the trees lean in toward the center. A dark form near the middle of the flock could be a shepherd or thick tree stump. The print is inscribed in graphite in the lower margin to the right, “MLiebermann.”

artworks.title: Sacrifice of Abraham
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 23.1 x 31.5 cm (9 1/8 x 12 3/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape from an elevated perspective. The horizon is high, showing distant hills and mountains behind a village. Various buildings, including a church with a tower, are visible on the horizon. The detailed engraving features intricate line work, typical of etching, capturing textures on rocks, trees, and structures. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of grey to black for depth and contrast. In the foreground, there are depictions of vegetation, livestock, figures, and horses on a path. Further back, a village with buildings and a bridge over a stream leads to the mountainous horizon.

artworks.title: Lamech and Cain
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 11.8 x 7.7 cm (4 5/8 x 3 1/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a woodland scene featuring two figures engaged in archery. One figure is holding a bow, drawing an arrow from a quiver on their back, while an unseen target is indicated by the posture and gaze. A second figure looks upward, seemingly pointing or gesturing towards an unseen object or target, holding a bow. The figures are dressed in simple, rugged clothing with an emphasis on the muscular form. In the background, a dense thicket or grove is shown, with one figure seated on the ground. The date "1524" is noted in the upper left corner. The style of the drawing is detailed and precise, with an emphasis on line work and shading to create depth and texture in the figures and surrounding natural setting.

artworks.title: Battlefield
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 17.1 x 19.9 cm (6 3/4 x 7 13/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horseman surveying the aftermath of a battle scene. In the foreground, a rider on horseback appears engaged in looking over the fallen figures below, while the bodies of two figures lie lifeless on the ground. Another horse is standing or lying down near them. In the background, a skirmish seems to be taking place on a ridge, where several figures on horseback are depicted with raised flags. The drawing employs fine linework and shading to convey a sense of motion and a somber atmosphere in a historical or mythological context.
